title: Self-Hosted Doesn’t Keep the Blast Radius Outside. It Moves It Into Your Network.

items.claim: Cursor says its cloud agents can execute on pools of Self-Hosted Machines that customers manage.
items.note: Matches the supplied Cursor excerpt exactly in substance.

items.claim: The supplied material does not disclose permissions, isolation, platforms, quotas, pricing, or security architecture.

items.claim: Claims about isolation, sandboxing, billing, command controls, tenant separation, activity inspection, and data-boundary protections are not documented product facts in this evidence package.

seo_title: Self-Hosted AI Agents Move Risk Into Your Network
seo_summary: Self-hosted cloud agents may keep execution closer to home—but they also move accountability, controls, and incident response inside.

cover.alt: A dark internal server room with a centrally framed rack whose ventilation grille glows red among cooler status lights.
cover.caption: The blast radius did not vanish; it changed address.
